name: Dropbox
summary:
Dropbox’s open-box mark is the tab icon on dropbox.com. It is the file-hosting site’s favicon, not a folder icon from the desktop client unless the host served that file.

Checked 12 November 2026 against dropbox.com. HTML came from https://www.dropbox.com/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: shortcut icon → https://cfl.dropboxstatic.com/static/metaserver/static/images/favicon.ico.

The favicon.ico URL is https://cfl.dropboxstatic.com/static/metaserver/static/images/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 4286 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 32×32.
